fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-08-18 (afternoon, 16:45): Rs. 1,50,000 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved. Eswari Sri submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000024. A person named Hemanth Arumugam, associated with the number 9000000264, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complaint refers to Madhan Palanisamy, a driver, reachable on 9000000295. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents, a call detail reference and social media screenshots.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Digital document; Call detail reference; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, suspect, digital document, associate, main street, call detail, mobile number
